title: On a Problem Posed by Brezis and Mironescu
summary: The purpose of this note is to present a positive answer to an open problem proposed in the recent book \cite{Brezis-Mironescu} by H. Brezis and P. Mironescu. It has been stated in this book {\it Sobolev Maps to the Circle} as Proposition 4.3. We demonstrate, in particular, the value of the least mass of the area minimizing integral rectifiable currents with a given boundary equals to the infimum of areas among smoothly immersed submanifolds with the same boundary, under the assumption that the boundary is that of a smooth submanifold.
